articles.title: ‘Absolutely unacceptable’: Japan condemns visit by Vladimir Putin to disputed Kuril Islands

zh.highlight: AI 驱动的时尚可视化与虚拟试穿工具包，用于基于同意的服装编辑、服装原型设计和创意设计工作流。
zh.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库介绍了一个 AI 驱动的时尚可视化与虚拟试穿工具包，主打基于用户同意的服装编辑、服装原型设计和创意设计流程。项目拥有 773 颗星和近期活跃动态，并提供 undress.design 在线编辑入口，值得关注其实际应用和部署路径。
zh.failureAnalysis: 虚拟试穿赛道竞争激烈，且“基于同意”的服装编辑在实际产品中难以被验证和强制执行。AI 生成服装的质感与真实感可能不足，用户对换装准确性和人体图像数据隐私存疑。项目目前只有 GitHub 星标和演示链接，缺少清晰的获客与付费路径。服装版权、模特肖像权和平台合规也可能成为工程之外的硬约束。

en.highlight: AI-powered fashion visualization and virtual try-on toolkit for consent-based garment editing, outfit prototyping, and creative design workflows.
en.summary: This GitHub repository describes an AI-driven fashion visualization and virtual try-on toolkit focused on consent-based garment editing, outfit prototyping, and creative design workflows. With 773 stars and recent activity, it offers an online editor at undress.design, making it worth watching for deployment and practical use.
en.failureAnalysis: Virtual try-on is a crowded market, and 'consent-based' editing is hard to enforce in practice, while garment quality, privacy, and copyright constraints can block adoption. Without a clear path to distribution or monetization, the project remains a demo rather than a product.
en.title: undress-design: AI-Powered Fashion Visualization and Virtual Try-On Toolkit
